details.description: Luxor refillable permanent marker with bold black smudge-resistant ink that writes on most surfaces. Pack of 10.
details.usageInstructions: Remove the cap and write. Replace the cap tightly after use.
details.dangerWarnings: Contains solvent-based ink. Use in a ventilated place. Keep away from children.
